name: Brady Danger / Caution Heavy Duty Non-Adhesive Barricade Tape (75mm x 300m)
shortDescription: High-strength 75mm x 300m non-adhesive virgin polyethylene caution barricade tape with bold non-fade 'DANGER' print for perimeter cordon and excavation marking.
overview: The Brady Industrial Barricade Warning Tape is the worldwide industry standard for cordoning off hazardous zones, open trench excavations, chemical spill perimeters, and active demolition areas. Extruded from 100% virgin, co-extruded low-density polyethylene (LDPE), this non-adhesive warning ribbon possesses high tensile strength and over 300% elongation, allowing it to withstand high winds without snapping. The bold black 'DANGER' lettering printed on an attention-commanding red and white diagonal striped background is formulated with UV-stabilized inks that resist fading under blazing sunlight.
keyFeatures: Heavy-duty virgin polyethylene (LDPE) film resists tearing, rotting, and embrittlement
Bold high-contrast black 'DANGER' warning legend printed repeatedly along 300 meters
UV-stabilized outdoor formulation prevents fading and cracking under direct sunlight
Non-adhesive design ties effortlessly around scaffolding, safety cones, and rebar stakes
High tensile elongation (> 300%) prevents tape breakage during blustery gale winds
Complies with OSHA 1910.144 and OSHA 1926.200 physical hazard marking regulations
Convenient 300-meter spool provides economical coverage for large construction perimeters
applications: Excavation perimeter marking and open manhole barricading
Chemical spill isolation and asbestos abatement zones
Structural crane lifting areas and overhead swing-radius cordons
Crime scenes, fire emergencies, and traffic accident sites
